name: attendify
description: AI-powered attendance management system with face recognition and anti-spoofing

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w attendify-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w attendify-web && npm run build -w attendify-landing
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w attendify-web
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db-main db-biometric redis
